rows.source: \S\ref{sec:predictions}\newline \pywit{dark}{p32040}{P3}, \leanwit{FrcMathlib}{p32040}{P3}; rests on B4, B8, C6, C9 \lean{Dark.wide\_binary\_band}

rows.label: P4
rows.predicate: Pressure-supported systems (ellipticals, dSphs, UDGs) lie below the cold-disk relation by the coherence factor $\sqrt{w}$, $w=1/(1+(\sigma_v/v)^{2})$, by $0.05$--$0.15$\,dex for $\sigma_v/v=0.5$--$1$, correlating with $\sigma_v/v$. Falsifier: pressure-supported systems on the cold-disk relation.
rows.source: \S\ref{sec:predictions}\newline \pywit{dark}{p32041}{P4}, \leanwit{FrcMathlib}{p32041}{P4}; rests on B4, B6, C10 \lean{Dark.coherence\_offset}

rows.label: P5
rows.predicate: Coherence-state cluster gas: the X-ray gas gravitates only when bulk-coherent, contributing in a relaxed cluster ($C_{ij}\to1$) and dropping out of a merger ($C_{ij}\to0$), the lensing displacement growing with the shock Mach number; the quantitative core residual of the same law is the conjecture Y1. Falsifier: a merger lensing peak tracking the shocked gas, or no relaxed-versus-merging difference.
rows.source: Eq.~\eqref{eq:cohsum}, \S\ref{sec:predictions}\newline \pywit{dark}{p32042}{P5}, \leanwit{FrcCore}{p32042}{P5}; rests on B6, C10 \lean{FRC.Dark.cohsum\_three, FRC.Drift.locked\_sum}

rows.label: P6
rows.predicate: A global, isotropic scale and no dark substructure: the registered acceleration depends on the baryonic field and the one global $\az$ alone, strictly increasing, with no direction or environment in the law once the external field is in its argument; no new dark-matter state and no dark subhaloes, so stream perturbations and the satellite abundance trace baryons alone. Falsifier: a directional or density dependence of $\az$ beyond the external-field effect, or stream gaps and substructure lensing with no baryonic counterpart.
rows.source: B1, B3; \S\ref{sec:predictions}\newline \pywit{dark}{p32043}{P6}, \leanwit{FrcMathlib}{p32043}{P6}; rests on C9 \lean{Dark.rar\_monotone}

rows.label: P1
rows.predicate: Gell-Mann--Okubo exact at leading order; PDG $0.57\%$, the bounded $\chi_3^2$ second order. Falsifier: a violation beyond the second-order insertion.
rows.source: C2\newline \pywit{hadrons}{p35051}{P1}, \leanwit{FrcCore}{p35051}{P1}, \leanwit{FrcMathlib}{p35051}{P1}; rests on B4 \lean{FRC.Hadrons.gmo, Hadrons.gmo\_pdg}

rows.label: P2
rows.predicate: Decuplet equal spacing exact; PDG $9.2\%$ spread, $\beta\simeq146.8$ MeV, the same second order. Falsifier: a non-equal spacing beyond it.
rows.source: C3\newline \pywit{hadrons}{p35052}{P2}, \leanwit{FrcCore}{p35052}{P2}, \leanwit{FrcMathlib}{p35052}{P2}; rests on B4 \lean{FRC.Hadrons.spacing, Hadrons.spacing\_pdg}

rows.label: P3
rows.predicate: The hyperfine pattern $g_{\mathrm{spin}}=\half S(S+1)-\tfrac98$, octet $-\tfrac34$, decuplet $+\tfrac34$, separation $\tfrac32A_{\mathrm{light}}$ with $A_{\mathrm{light}}\simeq195$ MeV. Falsifier: a spin splitting outside this pattern.
rows.source: C5\newline \pywit{hadrons}{p35053}{P3}, \leanwit{FrcCore}{p35053}{P3}, \leanwit{FrcMathlib}{p35053}{P3}; rests on B3, C6 \lean{FRC.Hadrons.spin\_pattern, Hadrons.a\_light, Hadrons.spin\_pattern}

rows.label: P5
rows.predicate: No exotic light multiplets beyond the $\mathbf 8$ and $\mathbf{10}$ at leading wrap order. Falsifier: a confirmed light baryon outside the $\mathbf 8$ and $\mathbf{10}$ at the wrap scale.
rows.source: C1\newline \pywit{hadrons}{p35055}{P5}, \leanwit{FrcCore}{p35055}{P5}; rests on B1, B2 \lean{FRC.Hadrons.flavour\_cube}

rows.label: P6
rows.predicate: Coleman--Glashow exact at one body; PDG $0.79\%$, the residual the two-body electromagnetic term; the orderings $M_n>M_p$ and $M_\Sigma>M_\Lambda$ fixed. Falsifier: a Coleman--Glashow violation beyond the two-body term.
rows.source: C7, C8, C9\newline \pywit{hadrons}{p35056}{P6}, \leanwit{FrcCore}{p35056}{P6}, \leanwit{FrcMathlib}{p35056}{P6} \lean{FRC.Hadrons.coleman\_glashow, Hadrons.cg\_pdg}

rows.label: P7
rows.predicate: Heavy-quark symmetry $M_{\Lambda_b}-M_{\Lambda_c}=M_B-M_D$ ($2.4\%$) and the $1/m_Q$ hyperfine ratio $(M_{\Sigma_c^{*}}-M_{\Sigma_c})/(M_{\Sigma^{*}}-M_{\Sigma})\simeq m_s/m_c$. Falsifier: a heavy-baryon spectrum off the spin-decoupled, $1/m_Q$-scaled pattern.

rows.label: P8
rows.predicate: Second-order decuplet relation \eqref{eq:thirddiff}, the vanishing third difference; PDG $6$ MeV ($0.36\%$). Falsifier: a third difference beyond the few-MeV third-order scale.
